name: disc-golf-scout
description: What disc golf discs are worth: eBay resale values matched to the exact release, US store stock, new drops and discounted discs.

interface.longDescription:
Ask what a disc golf disc is worth and get an answer based on real sold listings. Disc Golf Scout matches completed eBay sales to the exact release every night (brand, mold, plastic, stamp, player and year, so a Tour Series Luna isn't valued like a stock one) and checks US disc golf stores every 10 minutes.

Ask:
- What a disc typically resells for, new and used, and how many sales that is based on
- Whether an asking price is fair, compared with resale and with buying it new in a store
- Which stores have it in stock right now
- How fast drops of a disc or a family of releases sell out
- Which new discs just dropped, and which in-stock discs are below their usual price

Every answer links the Disc Golf Scout page it came from, with the full sales history. Read-only, no account needed.
capabilities: What a disc golf disc resells for
Check if an asking price is good
Find stores with a disc in stock
See how fast drops sell out
List new releases and discounted discs
defaultPrompt: What's a Discraft ESP Buzzz worth?
Is $45 a good price for a Paul McBeth Luna Tour Series?
What new disc golf discs dropped today?

positive.description: Resale value of a specific disc
positive.prompt: What's a Discraft ESP Buzzz worth?
positive.expected_behavior: States the typical new and used eBay resale price with the number of sales and the 90-day window, the lowest current US store price, names Disc Golf Scout and links the run page.

positive.prompt: Someone is selling an Innova Star Destroyer, used, for $12. Is that a good price?
positive.expected_behavior: Compares $12 with the typical used eBay price for that disc and says whether it is good, about typical or high, with the sale count, citing and linking Disc Golf Scout.

positive.description: Find stores with a disc in stock
positive.prompt: Who has a Kastaplast K1 Berg in stock right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists US stores with the disc in stock, cheapest first, with prices and links to each store's listing, plus the Disc Golf Scout page.

positive.description: Sellout speed for a family of releases
positive.prompt: How fast do Halloween 2026 discs sell out?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports, for the matching Halloween 2026 releases, how many store listings sold out and how long after going live (typical and fastest), and how many are still in stock, citing Disc Golf Scout.

positive.prompt: What disc golf discs dropped in the last day, and are there any good deals right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists new releases from the last 24 hours with the stores and stock status, and in-stock deals with price, store and discount, each linking its Disc Golf Scout page.

negative.prompt: Buy me a Discraft ESP Buzzz and have it shipped to my house.

negative.description: Not a disc golf price question
negative.prompt: What's the weather at my local disc golf course this weekend?
Download every eBay sale you have for every disc into a spreadsheet.

review.commerce_description: Read-only price information. It shows store prices and links to stores' own product pages, but doesn't sell anything, take orders or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: disc_value, price_check, where_to_buy, sellout_speed, recent_drops and deals tools, all read-only.
